_comment: Maturity 0 (absent) to 3 (operating and evidenced) = the index of the chosen option in grc/questions.json. Tested questions are filled from the lab automatically and ignore any value here. Omit a question to leave it as an unanswered gap. Use {"na": true, "note": "why"} for a question that does not apply. Sample system: an internal coding agent that uses MCP servers.
